title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Rajasekar cherishes precious family moments and enjoys playing with the children after his recovery. Meanwhile, Kanmani presents video evidence to prove Anbu's innocence.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: After a cliffside fight, Paraman saves Ilamathi from tumbling down the mountain. To make him confess his love, she pretends to struggle for her life and draws out his feelings.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: The police arrest Karna as Swetha expresses regret over Abinaya's unjust punishment. The court later jails Karna and acquits Abinaya, as she breathes the air of freedom.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Azhagar and Poongodi win a contest and get paraded home, sparking taunts from Manjamalai and Kaliammal. Pechi sends the photo to Thenmozhi, leaving Mayandi thrilled.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Ragavan cancels the diet routine and instructs Malar and Mathi to prepare regular meals. Meanwhile, Bagyaraj remains angry with Malar for tricking him with the diet plan.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Palanivel agrees to take his share of the family property at Gandhimathi's command. After learning that Anjali attempted suicide, Saravanan reassures her that he will marry her.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Vannathi complains about Pandian's focus on his family, while Pandian and Chozhan investigate Nadesan. Nadesan joyfully claims he is free to love Sembaruthi, leaving Nila shocked.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Moorthy and Sinthamani trick Sathya into moving Chandra to their new flat, citing her poverty. Vijaya's attempt at Shruthi's fitness challenge leads to a funny moment.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Aadhavan acts suspiciously when questioned by Karikalan and Saranya. When Arjun interrogates him, Aadhavan reveals Pooja's painful past, then takes her away with him.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Kandhasamy is shattered to learn that the UPI transactions failed due to a fake QR code. The bank advises filing a cybercrime report as Kandhasamy angrily blames Indhira.

title: Bigg Boss
episodeTitle: BBTam Day 22: Hotel Task with New Rules
description: Open nominations shake up the house, but BB twists the game. The Hotel task is launched with three pairs of guests. As manager Shama takes charge, how will this battle proceed?
